```{r}
# reading MVs

mv <- read.delim("MV_clustering.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

mv <- cbind(mv$samples, (-1)*mv[,-1])
colnames(mv)[1] <- "samples"

dim(mv)
```


```{r}
# MCP data analysis with MVs

mcp <- read.delim("4L_20260422_COLOSSUS_st2_3_MCPCounter_immune_1M_134_samples.txt",stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
mcp <- t(mcp)
mcp <- cbind(rownames(mcp),data.matrix(mcp))
colnames(mcp)[1] <- "Sample"
dim(mcp)

# Ensure it's a data.frame
mcp <- as.data.frame(mcp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Convert all columns except Sample to numeric
mcp[ , setdiff(colnames(mcp), "Sample")] <-
  lapply(mcp[ , setdiff(colnames(mcp), "Sample")], as.numeric)

# Check
str(mcp)
head(mcp[,1:5])
```


```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

# ---- STEP 1: Load and clean FGA data ----
fga <- read.delim("20240526_CINmetrics_COLOSSUS_output_with_COLOSSUS_ID.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Rename sample ID column and standardize format
fga <- fga %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = id.ID.GENERATOR) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample = gsub("-", ".", Sample))

# ---- STEP 2: Clean MV1 and MCP ----
# mv (MV score matrix) is read in the first chunk
mv1_df <- mv %>%
 dplyr:: rename(Sample = samples) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, MV1) %>%
 dplyr:: mutate(Sample = gsub("-", ".", Sample))

# Rename first column of MCP to 'Sample'
mcp <- mcp %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = 1)

# ---- STEP 3: Merge datasets ----
df_fga_mcp <- inner_join(fga, mcp, by = "Sample")
df_mv1_mcp <- inner_join(mv1_df, mcp, by = "Sample")

# ---- STEP 4: Correlation function ----
get_cor_results <- function(df, y_col, exclude = NULL) {
  cols_to_test <- names(df)[!(names(df) %in% c("Sample", y_col, exclude))]
  map_dfr(cols_to_test, function(var) {
    x <- df[[var]]
    y <- df[[y_col]]
    if (sum(is.finite(x)) > 2 && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      test <- cor.test(x, y, method = "pearson")
      tibble(
        feature = var,
        correlation = test$estimate,
        p_value = test$p.value
      )
    } else {
      tibble(feature = var, correlation = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
    }
  })
}

# ---- STEP 5: Compute correlations ----
results_fga <- get_cor_results(df_fga_mcp, "fga", exclude = c("tai", "cna", "base_segments", "break_points")) %>%
  mutate(metric = "FGA")

results_mv1 <- get_cor_results(df_mv1_mcp, "MV1") %>%
  mutate(metric = "MV1")

# ---- STEP 6: Combine results and format ----
combined_results <- bind_rows(results_fga, results_mv1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(correlation)) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not significant"),
    group = interaction(metric, significant),
    feature = fct_reorder(feature, correlation)
  )

#write.table(combined_results,"20250515_COLOSSUS_MV1_FGA_MCP_counter_barplot_combined_results.txt", sep ="\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- STEP 7: Plot (No r/p labels) ----

#pdf("4L_20260422_cell types_COLOSSUS_MV1_FGA_MCP_counter_barplot_combined.pdf")

ggplot(combined_results, aes(x = correlation, y = feature, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FGA.Significant" = "#1f77b4",
      "FGA.Not significant" = "#aec7e8",
      "MV1.Significant" = "#ff7f0e",
      "MV1.Not significant" = "#ffbb78"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "FGA.Significant" = "FGA (p < 0.05)",
      "FGA.Not significant" = "FGA (n.s.)",
      "MV1.Significant" = "MV1 (p < 0.05)",
      "MV1.Not significant" = "MV1 (n.s.)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of MCP Cell Types with FGA and MV1",
    x = "Pearson Correlation Coefficient",
    y = "MCP Cell Type",
    fill = "Metric + Significance"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(min(combined_results$correlation) - 0.2,
                           max(combined_results$correlation) + 0.2))
dev.off()
```
